claims.statement: The aggregated battery record identifies Orbtronic CGR18650CH as a 2250mAh, unprotected button-top 18650 variant.
Steam Engine preserves Orbtronic CGR18650CH 2250mAh 4.4C as a 2250mAh preset with a 4.4C runtime rating.

The Orbtronic CGR18650CH catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
No reliable exact-model market-introduction date was established for Orbtronic CGR18650CH in the 2026-08-04 catalog-wide research pass.
